applies_to: All future client-facing SEO reports created in this project
source: User-supplied brand JSON and logo on 2026-10-01; font files retrieved from the agency website

layout.header: Black masthead, original white/yellow vector logo, yellow period label
layout.footer: Black footer with agency/client and yellow page number
layout.body: White content pages, black headings, pale neutral tables, yellow KPI panel

font_provenance.conversion: WOFF2 retained; Satoshi CFF outlines converted to TrueType quadratic outlines for PDF embedding; Instrument Sans instantiated at weight 700 and width 100.

reporting_rules: Keep report scope and actual completion dates distinct.
Do not attribute enquiries to SEO without source evidence.
Use current period evidence; never carry old metrics forward as new.
No personal enquiry data in client reports.
Render and visually inspect every final page before delivery.
